datasetStatus.noteEn: Registered voters are from the Central Bureau of Statistics. The National Religious Party’s and Lider’s votes are taken from their polling-station totals. All elected candidates are listed; on 10 winning lists the candidates below them are not, and 3 lists that won no seats have no candidates listed.

datasetStatus.noteEn: List votes follow the result declared in the official notice, by which the seats were given out; its printed total of valid votes, 3,792,472, was officially corrected to 3,792,742 on 12 February 2013. In the Elections Committee's final results, which match every polling station, three lists differ slightly (Likud–Yisrael Beiteinu +109, Kadima −107, Hayisraelim −2), so the map and the list of places differ from the main table by up to 109 votes. Both versions give exactly the same seats. Candidate lists are as first published; later changes are not shown.
